IDX={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAs)}
def nw(s1,s2,g=-9):
    a=np.array([IDX.get(c,-1) for c in s1]);b=np.array([IDX.get(c,-1) for c in s2]);n,m=len(a),len(b)
    S=np.where((a[:,None]>=0)&(b[None,:]>=0),B62[np.clip(a,0,19)[:,None],np.clip(b,0,19)[None,:]],-4).astype(float)
    F=np.zeros((n+1,m+1));P=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),dtype=np.int8)
    F[1:,0]=g*np.arange(1,n+1);P[1:,0]=1;F[0,1:]=g*np.arange(1,m+1);P[0,1:]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        diag=F[i-1,:-1]+S[i-1];up=F[i-1,1:]+g
        row=np.maximum(diag,up);ptr=np.where(diag>=up,0,1).astype(np.int8);Fi=F[i];Pi=P[i];prev=Fi[0]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            v=row[j-1];p=ptr[j-1];l=prev+g
            if l>v:v=l;p=2
            Fi[j]=v;Pi[j]=p;prev=v
    i,j=n,m;A=[];Bq=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        p=P[i,j]
        if p==0:A.append(s1[i-1]);Bq.append(s2[j-1]);i-=1;j-=1
        elif p==1:A.append(s1[i-1]);Bq.append('-');i-=1
        else:A.append('-');Bq.append(s2[j-1]);j-=1
    return "".join(reversed(A)),"".join(reversed(Bq))
def map12(s1,s2):
    A,Bq=nw(s1,s2);i=j=0;mp={}
    for x,y in zip(A,Bq):
        if x!='-':i+=1
        if y!='-':j+=1
        if x!='-':mp[i]=(j if y!='-' else None)
    return mp
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}

def chseq(v):
    r=sorted({(a[0],a[1]) for a in v});return "".join(AA3[x[1]] for x in r),[x[0] for x in r]
def contacts(v1,v2,cut=4.5):
    X=np.array([[a[2],a[3],a[4]] for a in v1]);Y=np.array([[a[2],a[3],a[4]] for a in v2])
    r1=np.array([a[0] for a in v1]);r2=np.array([a[0] for a in v2])
    ii,jj=np.where(((X[:,None,:]-Y[None,:,:])**2).sum(-1)<cut*cut)
    return set(zip(r1[ii].tolist(),r2[jj].tolist()))
sA,rA=chseq(ch['A']); sB,rB=chseq(ch['B'])

def stream(query):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/stream",params={"query":query,"format":"fasta"},headers=H,timeout=120)
    out={};name=None
    for l in r.text.split("\n"):
        if l.startswith(">"): name=l.split("|")[1] if "|" in l else l[1:20]; out[name]=""
        elif name: out[name]+=l.strip()
    return out

famB=stream('(reviewed:true) AND (protein_name:"Succinate--CoA ligase") AND (protein_name:"subunit beta") AND (length:[370 TO 450])')
famA={k:v for k,v in list(famA.items())[:28]}; famB={k:v for k,v in list(famB.items())[:28]}
print("family set sizes: alpha",len(famA),"beta",len(famB))
def col_cons(ref,fam,ifaceidx,label):
    hits=np.zeros(len(ref)); tot=0
    for k,s in fam.items():
        m=map12(ref,s); tot+=1
        for i in range(1,len(ref)+1):
            q=m[i]
            if q and s[q-1]==ref[i-1]: hits[i-1]+=1
    cons=hits/tot
    mask=np.zeros(len(ref),bool); mask[[i-1 for i in ifaceidx]]=True
    u=stats.mannwhitneyu(cons[mask],cons[~mask],alternative="greater")
    print(f"\n{label}: n={tot} reviewed family members")
    print(f"   interface columns     mean identity to E. coli = {cons[mask].mean():.3f} (n={mask.sum()})")
    print(f"   non-interface columns mean identity to E. coli = {cons[~mask].mean():.3f} (n={(~mask).sum()})")
    print(f"   difference {cons[mask].mean()-cons[~mask].mean():+.3f}; Mann-Whitney one-sided p = {u.pvalue:.2e}")
    return cons,mask
